assumptions.clear_sky_weather_status: pvlib theoretical envelope; not measured weather
assumptions.connection_limit_basis: site transformer HV active power, including transformer and converter losses; positive import and negative export checked separately
assumptions.connection_limit_response: report and fail the screen; no implicit connection upgrade, charger derating or PV curtailment
assumptions.planning_yield_status: scenario peak-sun-hours with canonical temperature and worst-soiling derates
assumptions.site_transformer_sizing_basis: greater of installed rectifier input or declared grid import, divided by power factor, with 25% planning headroom
assumptions.station_power_path: PV and storage feed a common DC bus; only residual import/export crosses the modeled AC interface

limitations: Two steady-state cases on an ideal common 33 kV bus; feeder routes, upstream capacity, protection and utility approval are not represented.
Storage discharge is a stipulated snapshot, not a proof of available state of charge or endurance.
Exceedances require a controlled connection upgrade, charging schedule/derating or export-control design with timetable and cost reconciliation.
